explanation: OEIS A105751 (P. Bala): 'every prime p divides some term of this sequence'. The formal statement requires a nonzero term divisible by p, which avoids the trivial a(0) = 0 and is the meaningful reading. The docstring's justification (n(n+1)/2 | a(n), so odd p | a(p); 2 | a(4) = −40) is consistent. The formal a (imaginary part of Π_{k=0}^n (1 + k i), an integer, so floor is harmless) reproduces 0, 1, 3, 0, −40. Faithful.
